pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal regions with sharp pixel-level edge gradients; geometry consists of irregular 4- to 6-sided shapes; patch size exhibits a reduction gradient from the dorsal midline toward the ventral and posterior extremities.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Network of light-colored interstitial pathways forming a continuous topological mesh; junction nodes are characterized by 3-way and 4-way intersections; pathway thickness is narrow and relatively uniform across the central flank.
